package handler

import (
	db "example.com/merge-casual-practice/db"
	playerentity "example.com/merge-casual-practice/game/entities/player"
	casual "example.com/merge-casual-practice/game/mergecasual"
	"github.com/tjbdwanghaibo/roost-core/framework/entity"
	"time"
)

type IMergePlayerEntity interface {
	entity.IThreadSafeEntity
	Dao() *db.PlayerDao
	TimerComp() *playerentity.TimerComponent
}

// 登录票序号由已鉴权入口持久分配。密钥来自服务端 crypto/rand；Rules 捕获 configdata Snapshot。
// 同票重试不提高 Epoch；更新票接管后旧设备不能再写，操作序号不重置。
//
//roost:nest rollback=undo durability=strict
func handlerMergeLogin(player IMergePlayerEntity, key string, ticket uint64, now int64, rules casual.Rules) (casual.View, error) {
	if ticket == 0 {
		return casual.View{}, casual.ErrRule
	}
	if player.Dao().GetState() == "" {
		if ticket != 1 {
			return casual.View{}, casual.ErrRule
		}
		s, err := casual.NewState(key, now, rules)
		if err != nil {
			return casual.View{}, err
		}
		player.Dao().SetState(s.Encode())
		return s.View(), nil
	}
	s, err := casual.Decode(player.Dao().GetState())
	if err != nil {
		return casual.View{}, err
	}
	if key != s.Key || ticket < s.Epoch || ticket > s.Epoch+1 {
		return casual.View{}, casual.ErrRule
	}
	if ticket == s.Epoch {
		return s.View(), nil
	}
	if ticket > uint64(casual.ValueLimit) || s.Revision >= uint64(casual.ValueLimit) {
		return casual.View{}, casual.ErrRule
	}
	if err := s.Recover(now); err != nil {
		return casual.View{}, err
	}
	s.Epoch = ticket
	s.Revision++
	s.Sale = casual.Sale{}
	if err := saveMerge(player, s); err != nil {
		return casual.View{}, err
	}
	return s.View(), nil
}

// 一个离线批次最多 16 步，全部成功才 SetState。公网只接收 Command，不接收 State / Rules / serverNow。
//
//roost:nest rollback=undo durability=strict
func handlerMergeBatch(player IMergePlayerEntity, commands []casual.Command, now int64) ([]casual.Receipt, error) {
	if len(commands) == 0 || len(commands) > 16 {
		return nil, casual.ErrRule
	}
	s, err := casual.Decode(player.Dao().GetState())
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	before := s.Revision
	receipts := make([]casual.Receipt, 0, len(commands))
	for _, c := range commands {
		r, err := s.Apply(c, now)
		if err != nil {
			return nil, err
		}
		receipts = append(receipts, r)
	}
	if s.Revision != before {
		if err := saveMerge(player, s); err != nil {
			return nil, err
		}
	}
	return receipts, nil
}

// 广告回调的签名密钥来自服务端依赖装配；该 Sender 不是允许客户端传 key 的公开 endpoint。
//
//roost:nest rollback=undo durability=strict
func handlerMergeAd(player IMergePlayerEntity, proof casual.SignedReward, verificationKey string, epoch uint64, now int64) (casual.View, error) {
	s, err := casual.Decode(player.Dao().GetState())
	if err != nil {
		return casual.View{}, err
	}
	before := s.Revision
	if err := s.GrantAd(proof, verificationKey, player.ID(), epoch, now); err != nil {
		return casual.View{}, err
	}
	if s.Revision != before {
		if err := saveMerge(player, s); err != nil {
			return casual.View{}, err
		}
	}
	return s.View(), nil
}

// 读视图也在 Player 锁内取得；不顺便推进时间，因此客户端需显式 recover 后再以新版本发离线批次。
//
//roost:nest rollback=undo durability=strict
func handlerMergeView(player IMergePlayerEntity) (casual.View, error) {
	s, err := casual.Decode(player.Dao().GetState())
	if err != nil {
		return casual.View{}, err
	}
	return s.View(), nil
}

func saveMerge(player IMergePlayerEntity, s casual.State) error {
	old := player.Dao().GetWakeTimer()
	if old != 0 {
		player.TimerComp().RemoveTimer(old)
		player.Dao().SetWakeTimer(0)
	}
	player.Dao().SetState(s.Encode())
	if deadline := s.NextDeadline(); deadline != 0 {
		id := player.TimerComp().NewTimerAt(time.UnixMilli(deadline), playerentity.TimerChallenge, int64(s.Challenge.ID), 0, nil)
		if id == 0 {
			return casual.ErrRule
		}
		player.Dao().SetWakeTimer(id)
	}
	return nil
}

// 结果未知后按原 seq 查回执；新设备用当前 Epoch 查询旧操作，不改写旧命令的 Epoch 或 Seq 再发一次。
//
//roost:nest rollback=undo durability=strict
func handlerMergeReceipt(player IMergePlayerEntity, epoch, seq uint64) (casual.Receipt, error) {
	s, err := casual.Decode(player.Dao().GetState())
	if err != nil {
		return casual.Receipt{}, err
	}
	if epoch != s.Epoch || seq == 0 || seq > uint64(len(s.Receipts)) {
		return casual.Receipt{}, casual.ErrRule
	}
	return s.Receipts[seq-1], nil
}
